name: Viper Urn
disable: DC 15 Thievery check (trained) to stabilize the urn, or DC 15 Athletics check to carefully lower the heavy urn

items.name: Topple
items.text: When someone pulls the trip wire, the urn smashes against a creature in the doorway, making a shattering urn Strike against that creature, then releases a Viper into the square that contained the trap. The viper attacks any non-plant creature it detects.

text: A ceramic urn containing a coiled viper tips and shatters when a tripwire is pulled.
